plan.major: Family Life and Human Development - Family Studies Emphasis
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-12 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Family Life and Human Development - Family Studies Emphasis program page (poid=11009) and its linked official degree map, 'Family Life & Human Development Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Family Studies (Campus)', last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the BS: the catalog prints a single combined Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120, and the map expressly states that students electing the BA take 16 credits of one foreign language, which are not included in the map. All courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to be counted in the major (catalog program information). This plan follows the map's Campus tab; the workbook's Online tab was NOT used (it prints MATH 1040 at 3 credits against the catalog's 4). Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (15 in all eight terms) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120. The catalog curriculum reconciles: FLHD Core Requirements 30 (ten 3-credit courses, all placed on the map) plus the Math Requirement 3-4 (the map exercises MATH 1031 - Statistical Reasoning at the catalog's 3 credits, recorded as a choice slot with MATH 1040 - Statistical Inference, printed at 4 credits in the catalog, as the other option) plus the Family Studies Emphasis 30 (the map's ten generic 3-credit elective rows, recorded as choice slots carrying the catalog's emphasis list) = the printed Curriculum of 63-64, exercised at 63. The map's free rows total 38 credits (32 Free Electives + 6 Free Upper-division Electives), recorded as printed; the catalog prints no free-elective figure. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
